success_rule: All R/R observations must succeed; otherwise cost is infinite.
cost_rule: Median of all R costs for solved combinations; IQR uses numpy.quantile linear interpolation.
case_method_set_hash_format: sha256 of sorted [suite,problem,method] JSON arrays, ASCII, separators comma/colon

specific.total_cost_scope: Sum of per-problem median observed costs, including unsuccessful runs; not the median of suite totals.

cutest.total_cost_scope: Sum of per-problem median observed costs, including unsuccessful runs; not the median of suite totals.
